_meta: G7.1 J2 + G1 combat medics+ (DAMAGE71, docs/G71_SCOPE.md J2 / G1, Last Protocol only): rules.g71_care drives sim/systems/care71.gd. every = triage pass cadence (ticks); tag_r = a medic of the casualty's side within this many tiles tags it; black = down with < black_left_s on the bleed-out clock, or >= black_limbs limbs lost; red = down or bleeding >= red_bleed hp/s; yellow = bleeding or crawling; green = the rest. comfort_s = how long a black-tagged soldier on morphine lives (made comfortable, dies quietly). green_keep_s = a soldier patched up and walking again is re-tagged green by a medic and stays on the casualty list this many seconds (the tag stays on him). call_k = an untended down / crawling casualty calls for a medic every call_k passes. Every number is PROVISIONAL (untuned).

recover._note: PROVISIONAL (DAMAGE71-8). Medics recover our dead: every every_pass triage passes, on a side with no casualty listed, an idle medic walks to the nearest own body within seek_r tiles, works on it secs seconds within pick_r, then it is carried off (Gore71.remove, event BodyRecovered71).
